描述_EN: Square of polychrome tapestry composed in its central part of a bust inserted in a red medallion surrounded by yellow inscribed in a square. the spandrels are occupied by small two-tone red and spare lozenges. the second frame features a frieze of red posts lined on the left with a fine two-tone red and green braid. the first features a large frame with a green background, decorated in the corners with large flowers with numerous petals, separated at the top and bottom by unidentified animals (birds?), and on the sides by plant and geometric elements. two wide frames form a border to the central scene.
描述_ZN: carré de tapisserie polychrome，其中央部分是一个半身像，插在一个红色的奖章里，周围是黄色的方形刻字。 窗台被备用的双色小红点占据。 第二个框架是由左侧的红柱楣组成的，衬以精细的红绿双色辫子。 第一幅是一个绿色背景的大框架，角落里装饰着有许多花瓣的大花，顶部和底部被不知名的动物（鸟类）分开，侧面是植物和几何元素。 两个大框架围绕着中央场景形成一个边框。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
